name: ring-wrench
description: A ring wrench with an enclosed hexagonal head and a bent handle.
useCase: Identify ring wrenches or enclosed-head fastening tools.
misuse: Use a visible label when a tool identifies equipment, a product or an instruction.

24.reason: The larger ring head retains a broad opening beside the full handle.
